title: MpiSaveVideo returns the written file path, so one MpiClearVramEnd can close the chain
description: MpiSaveVideo is OUTPUT_NODE with RETURN_TYPES = (), so nothing downstream can be ordered after the mp4 is written. That forces an MpiClearVramEnd on every terminal branch (video decode, audio decode, latent) and puts the multi-second VRAM clear INSIDE render time. Returning the output path gives MpiClearVramEnd a trigger that fires after the file exists, so the user gets their output first and one terminal clear replaces the per-branch ones. Image workflows already end in a preview node that has an output, so they benefit without a change. Requested by Fabio, 2026-09-06.
